results.title: Punjab: CM approves over 120% hike in Adarsh School teachers’ salaries
results.description: According to an official release, the decision will benefit around 1,100 teachers and reaffirms the state government’s commitment that those shaping Punjab’s future must themselves receive fair compensation, dignity and due recognition

results.title: Russian military aircraft enter Korea air defense zone without notice
results.description: Several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea’s air defense identification zone over the East Sea without advance notice, prompting the Air Force to deploy fighter jets. No sovereign airspace was violated.
